# Peast

Peast v1.18.1, pinned at commit `70881e535f519aba943b6200411d2888d6c50dec`, under BSD-3-Clause. See LICENSE.

Source: https://github.com/mck89/peast/tree/70881e535f519aba943b6200411d2888d6c50dec

The PHP sources from upstream `lib/Peast/` use the isolated namespace `YangSheep\Cache\Vendor\Peast`. Namespace declarations, class references and dynamic class names were prefixed. The upstream runtime requires the PHP mbstring extension.
